## Summary / 变更摘要

Describe the user-visible effect and why this change is needed.

说明用户可见的效果，以及为什么需要这项修改。

## Validation / 验证

- [ ] `flutter analyze`
- [ ] `flutter test`
- [ ] Relevant Windows and/or Android behavior was checked / 已检查相关 Windows 和/或 Android 行为
- [ ] Screenshots and logs contain demo data only / 截图与日志只包含演示数据

## Risk and recovery / 风险与恢复

List database, cloud-sync, playback, signing, migration, or data-loss risks. Explain rollback or recovery where relevant.

列出数据库、云同步、播放、签名、迁移或数据丢失风险；如适用，请说明回滚或恢复方式。

## Documentation / 文档

- [ ] User-facing documentation is updated, or no update is needed / 已更新用户文档，或本次无需更新
- [ ] English remains primary and Simplified Chinese remains complete / 英文保持优先，简体中文内容完整
